messages:
arya: short note: observed RBAC auth spikes during dashboard rollouts. proposing a small change: materialize short-lived session-perm tokens at login and serve most panel auth locally.

mike: agree, remote auth on hot path kills p95. what's TTL?

arya: propose 10m for non-sensitive panels, 30s for sensitive ones. revocations via pubsub so we don't block.

lina: add guard: when revocation channel unhealthy gateways should fall back to 30s. also need per-tenant metrics for cache hit/miss.

syl: for query layer overload, return a cached snapshot with header "x-console-freshness" and a small UI badge. ops can force-refresh via an operator API.

infra-bot: canary-loadtest queued: tenants=5000, sensitive_ratio=0.02, start=02:00 UTC

mike: rollout idea: flag behind feature gate, 5% tenants -> 25% -> 100% with telemetry checks and auto-rollback on revocation_lag>3s.

lina: I'll draft the RFC addendum: revocation contract, token schema (bitmask roles), and failure-mode runbook.
